rows.label: qst620303_msg0001
rows.name: I've got what you asked for.

rows.label: qst620303_msg0002
rows.name: This is... a Bouquet Stone...

rows.label: qst620303_msg0003
rows.name: Wow! It's stunning...

rows.label: qst620303_msg0004
rows.name: It is the perfect gemstone for Ondina.

rows.label: qst620303_msg0005
rows.name: I'm really glad I asked you all...

rows.label: qst620303_msg0006
rows.name: Don't even mention it.

rows.label: qst620303_msg0007
rows.name:
Next is the place for the proposal,
right?

rows.label: qst620303_msg0008
rows.name: Yes! That's right!

rows.label: qst620303_msg0009
rows.name:
Hey, keep your voice down! I want to
keep it secret from Ondina for now.

rows.label: qst620303_msg0011
rows.name:
Um... I'm from Liberalitas, so maybe I
can show you somewhere.

rows.label: qst620303_msg0012
rows.name:
Is there somewhere romantic? Like
talking about our love while looking
at a white-sand beach...

rows.label: qst620303_msg0013
rows.name:
Hm. Baldotas Island might work, then?
Not that I know much about the
"talking about our love" part...

rows.label: qst620303_msg0014
rows.name: Let us go take a look. Take me there.

rows.label: qst620303_msg0015
rows.name: Got it.

rows.label: qst620303_msg0016
rows.name:
Ondina, something came up. Could you
wait here for me?

rows.label: qst620303_msg0017
rows.name: Really?

rows.label: qst620303_msg0018
rows.name:
If it is really only for a little
while...

rows.label: qst620303_msg0019
rows.name:
It's fine. I ran into an old friend
and just have something I want to talk
about.

rows.label: qst620303_msg0020
rows.name: I see... If you go far, be careful.

rows.label: qst620303_msg0021
rows.name: Will do!

rows.label: qst620303_msg0022
rows.name: [ML:Feeling kind=Think ]I wonder if that really fooled her...
